metadata.dataset_name: Terms of Service Academic Evaluation Dataset
metadata.description: Manually labeled dataset across 4 diverse service agreements for system benchmarking.

clauses.text: By registering for, accessing, or using the ApexCloud platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you must immediately discontinue all use of the platform.
clauses.rationale: Introductory acceptance of terms clause stating binding nature of agreement upon platform use.

clauses.text: To access the services, you must register for an account with valid contact credentials. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account login credentials and passwords, and you accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.
clauses.rationale: Account registration requirement and user responsibility to keep login credentials confidential.

clauses.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account immediately at our sole discretion, without prior notice or liability, for any conduct that we determine violates these Terms or harms other users.
clauses.rationale: Allows company immediate account suspension/termination without notice or liability for any conduct.

clauses.text: Upon termination of your account by either party, your access to the service will cease immediately and all stored workspace files and configuration data will be permanently deleted without possibility of recovery.
clauses.rationale: Specifies immediate cessation of access and permanent irreversible deletion of stored user workspace files.

clauses.text: All paid plans are billed in advance on a recurring monthly or annual basis. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle unless you cancel it at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration date.
clauses.rationale: Imposes recurring subscription billing with automatic renewal and a mandatory 30-day cancellation deadline.

clauses.text: All subscription fees paid to ApexCloud are strictly non-refundable, and no credits or prorated refunds will be issued for partial billing periods or unused accounts.
clauses.rationale: Expressly declares all paid subscription fees strictly non-refundable with no prorated refunds.

clauses.text: We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to modify our subscription fees and change service pricing at any time without prior individual notice to users.
clauses.rationale: Reserves right to modify subscription fees and change pricing at any time without prior individual notice.

clauses.text: By submitting, uploading, or displaying content on or through the service, you grant ApexCloud a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, transferable, and sublicensable license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, translate, and distribute such content in connection with operating the service.
clauses.rationale: Demands worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, transferable and sublicensable license to user content.

clauses.text: You represent and warrant that you own or have obtained all necessary intellectual property rights and permissions for all content you submit to the service, and that such content does not infringe any third-party copyrights or trademarks.
clauses.rationale: User warranty that uploaded content does not infringe third-party copyrights or trademarks.

clauses.text: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time without prior individual notice. Your continued use of the service following the posting of any changes constitutes binding acceptance of those revised terms.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to modify terms at any time without notice, with continued use deemed acceptance.

clauses.text: Notwithstanding any other provision, for material changes affecting subscription pricing or customer data usage, we will endeavor to provide thirty (30) days advance notice via email or platform dashboard prior to the revision taking effect.
clauses.rationale: Commitment to endeavor to provide 30 days notice for material changes to pricing or customer data usage.

clauses.text: We collect personal information, usage logs, device telemetry, and analytics regarding your interactions with the platform to operate and optimize the service in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
clauses.rationale: Standard collection of user data, device telemetry, and analytics under privacy policy.

clauses.text: We may share your personal data, telemetry, and behavioral analytics with third-party advertising partners and analytics vendors for cross-site tracking and commercial profiling.
clauses.rationale: Authorizes sharing personal data and telemetry with third-party ad partners for cross-site tracking and profiling.

clauses.text: Following the closure or termination of your account, we may retain your personal data and transaction records for up to seven (7) years to comply with statutory legal obligations and resolve potential disputes.
clauses.rationale: Retains personal data and transaction records for up to 7 years following account closure.

clauses.text: We use cookies to improve experience and maintain user sessions across platform workflows.
clauses.rationale: Standard cookie notice for service functionality and workflow session maintenance.

clauses.text: The services are provided strictly on an as-is and as-available basis, without warranty of any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory, including implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.
clauses.rationale: Standard disclaimer of express, implied, and statutory warranties on an as-is basis.

clauses.section_title: 17. Limitation of Liability and Damage Cap
clauses.text: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, in no event shall ApexCloud or its officers be liable for any special, incidental, indirect, or consequential damages whatsoever, and our aggregate liability for all claims shall not exceed fifty US dollars ($50.00).
clauses.rationale: Excludes consequential damages and severely caps total aggregate company liability at $50.00.

clauses.text: Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to these Terms shall be resolved exclusively through final and binding individual arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association.
clauses.rationale: Mandates binding individual arbitration under AAA rules in place of court proceedings.

clauses.section_title: 19. Class Action and Jury Trial Waiver
clauses.text: You expressly waive any right to initiate, join, or participate in any class action lawsuit, collective arbitration, or representative proceeding against ApexCloud.
clauses.rationale: Express waiver of right to participate in class action lawsuits, collective arbitration, or representative claims.

clauses.text: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, and any court proceedings permitted under these Terms shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Wilmington, Delaware.
clauses.rationale: Specifies Delaware governing law and exclusive venue in Wilmington state or federal courts.

clauses.text: Welcome to MarketGrid Commerce. By creating a merchant store or using our marketplace services, you enter into a legally binding agreement governed by these Merchant Terms of Service.
clauses.rationale: Introductory preamble establishing scope and legally binding nature of merchant terms.

clauses.text: Merchants must provide accurate business credentials during onboarding. You are solely responsible for safeguarding your store login credentials and must immediately report any unauthorized access to our support team.
clauses.rationale: Merchant onboarding credential requirement and obligation to safeguard store login access.

clauses.text: MarketGrid reserves the right to suspend or terminate your merchant account immediately, without notice or liability, for any violation of platform policies or fraudulent transaction activity.
clauses.rationale: Allows marketplace immediate account suspension without notice or liability for policy violations.

clauses.text: You may terminate your merchant store at any time through the merchant dashboard settings upon clearing all pending fulfillment orders.
clauses.rationale: Allows merchant to cancel store at any time via dashboard upon fulfilling orders.

clauses.text: Store hosting subscriptions renew automatically each month, and recurring billing charges will be deducted from your linked bank account unless cancelled at least 15 days prior to renewal.
clauses.rationale: Automatic monthly subscription renewal and recurring deductions with a 15-day cancellation notice window.

clauses.text: All monthly subscription fees and completed transaction processing fees are strictly non-refundable under all circumstances.
clauses.rationale: Declares all monthly subscription and transaction processing fees strictly non-refundable.

clauses.text: We reserve the right to modify commission rates, transaction fees, and platform pricing at any time without prior individual notice.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to change commission rates and transaction pricing at any time without notice.

clauses.text: By uploading product descriptions, media, and marketing copy, you grant MarketGrid a worldwide, perpetual, royalty-free, transferable license to use, reproduce, modify, and distribute such content for marketplace promotion.
clauses.rationale: Grants worldwide, perpetual, royalty-free, transferable license to product media and descriptions.

clauses.text: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless MarketGrid, its affiliates, and employees from any third-party claims, liabilities, or damages arising out of your products or content infringement.
clauses.rationale: Obligates merchant to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless marketplace from third-party product claims.

clauses.text: In no event shall MarketGrid be liable for any indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, and total aggregate liability shall not exceed the amount of fees paid by you in the preceding three months.
clauses.rationale: Excludes consequential damages and limits liability to fees paid in preceding three months.

clauses.text: The platform and payment gateway are provided on an as-is basis without warranty of any kind, whether express or implied.
clauses.rationale: Standard as-is marketplace and payment gateway warranty disclaimer.

clauses.text: MarketGrid may modify these terms at any time without prior notice. Your continued use of the marketplace constitutes binding acceptance of all revised terms.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral terms modification at any time with continued use constituting acceptance.

clauses.text: Merchants must handle buyer personal information in compliance with our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection regulations.
clauses.rationale: Requirement for merchants to handle customer data according to privacy policies.

clauses.text: We retain buyer transaction history and merchant audit logs for up to seven (7) years following account termination to satisfy tax and financial reporting mandates.
clauses.rationale: Retains buyer transaction history and merchant logs for 7 years following account termination.

clauses.text: All disputes arising under these terms shall be settled exclusively through binding individual arbitration administered by JAMS.
clauses.rationale: Mandates binding individual arbitration administered by JAMS for all disputes.

clauses.section_title: 16. Exception for Small Claims and Intellectual Property
clauses.text: Except as provided in Section 15, either party may assert qualifying claims in small claims court or seek injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction for intellectual property infringement.
clauses.rationale: Explicit exception permitting small claims court and injunctive relief for IP claims.

clauses.text: MarketGrid uses standard cookies to maintain session states and track checkout completion across the merchant portal.
clauses.rationale: Standard cookie and tracking notice for maintaining session states and checkout completion.

clauses.text: If any provision of these terms is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in full force and effect.
clauses.rationale: Standard boilerplate severability and entire agreement integration clause.

clauses.text: Welcome to PulseMedia. By accessing our mobile application or creating a member profile, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you disagree, do not use the application.
clauses.rationale: Welcome preamble and agreement to be bound by mobile application terms.

clauses.text: Users must provide accurate profile information and are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their passwords and account security.
clauses.rationale: User profile credential requirements and password security responsibility.

clauses.text: You may deactivate or terminate your account at any time through your mobile profile settings.
clauses.rationale: Permits user to deactivate or terminate account at any time via profile settings.

clauses.text: PulseMedia reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account at our sole discretion, without prior notice, for any violation of our Community Guidelines or for any reason whatsoever without liability.
clauses.rationale: Immediate account termination at company sole discretion without notice or liability for any reason.

clauses.text: Premium memberships require recurring payment charges billed monthly and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 48 hours prior to the next billing date.
clauses.rationale: Premium subscription auto-renews recurring charges monthly unless cancelled 48 hours prior.

clauses.text: All purchases of virtual badges, digital gifts, and premium membership fees are final and non-refundable.
clauses.rationale: Declares digital gifts, virtual badges, and premium membership fees non-refundable.

clauses.section_title: 7. User Posts and Perpetual License Grant
clauses.text: By submitting or publishing photos, text, video, or comments on PulseMedia, you grant us a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, and distribute your content across any media.
clauses.rationale: Demands worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to user posts, text, photos, and videos.

clauses.section_title: 8. Commercialization and Sublicensing of User Submissions
clauses.text: PulseMedia reserves the transferable and sublicensable right to commercialize, display, and create derivative works from user submissions for advertising and promotional purposes.
clauses.rationale: Sublicensable and transferable right to commercialize user submissions for promotional ads.

clauses.text: PulseMedia respects intellectual property laws and maintains a policy to respond promptly to notices of alleged copyright infringement under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act.
clauses.rationale: DMCA copyright infringement notification and takedown policy description.

clauses.section_title: 10. Behavioral Advertising and Third-Party Data Sharing
clauses.text: We share personal data, browsing telemetry, and behavioral profile information with advertising networks for cross-site tracking and targeted commercial promotions.
clauses.rationale: Shares personal data and browsing telemetry with ad networks for behavioral cross-site tracking.

clauses.text: Upon termination or deletion of your profile, we may retain personal data, usage logs, and interaction records indefinitely to prevent platform abuse and comply with law enforcement inquiries.
clauses.rationale: Retains personal data and interaction logs indefinitely after account deletion.

clauses.text: We reserve the right to amend these terms at any time without notice. Your continued use of PulseMedia following the posting of modifications constitutes acceptance of the amended terms.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to amend terms at any time with continued use deemed acceptance.

clauses.text: We encourage users to periodically review these terms to stay informed of our policies.
clauses.rationale: Encourages users to periodically review terms for updates.

clauses.text: PulseMedia services and community features are provided on an as-is and as-available basis, without warranties of any kind.
clauses.rationale: As-is and as-available warranty disclaimer for community features.

clauses.text: In no event shall PulseMedia or its creators be liable for any special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from the use or inability to use the platform.
clauses.rationale: Excludes consequential, special, and punitive damages arising from platform use.

clauses.text: You agree that any dispute resolution proceeding will be conducted solely on an individual basis and you waive any right to participate in a class action lawsuit or representative proceeding.
clauses.rationale: Waives right to participate in class action lawsuits or representative proceedings.

clauses.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of California, with exclusive venue in the state and federal courts located in San Francisco, California.
clauses.rationale: Governing California law and exclusive venue in San Francisco state/federal courts.

clauses.text: Section headings in this User Agreement are for convenience of reference only and carry no legal or contractual significance.
clauses.rationale: Standard headings clause stating section titles have no contractual significance.

clauses.text: By creating a developer account or generating an API key, you enter into this binding agreement governing programmatic access to DataForge cloud endpoints.
clauses.rationale: Preamble defining scope and binding agreement for programmatic API access.

clauses.text: You must keep your API keys and security credentials strictly confidential. You are responsible for all calls and data egress executed using your issued credentials.
clauses.rationale: API key confidentiality requirements and responsibility for data egress calls.

clauses.text: DataForge reserves the right to immediately suspend your API access or revoke your keys without notice for rate limit abuse, security threats, or breach of these terms.
clauses.rationale: Immediate API access revocation without notice for rate limit abuse or security issues.

clauses.text: You may request account deletion at any time, provided that all outstanding compute and bandwidth invoices are paid in full.
clauses.rationale: Permits developer account deletion once compute and bandwidth invoices are settled.

clauses.text: Developer subscriptions renew automatically on the first day of each calendar month, and recurring overage charges will be billed directly to the payment method on file.
clauses.rationale: Auto-renewal of usage tiers with recurring monthly overage fees billed directly.

clauses.text: All purchased API request credits and prepaid quota allowances are non-refundable and expire twelve months from purchase.
clauses.rationale: Prepaid API request credits are non-refundable and expire after 12 months.

clauses.text: We reserve the right to modify our pricing structure and increase API request rates at any time without prior individual notice.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to modify pricing structure and increase request rates without notice.

clauses.text: You retain all intellectual property rights in the applications you build using our endpoints, subject to the limited license granted to DataForge to process API payloads.
clauses.rationale: Developer retains IP in built applications, subject to processing license for payloads.

clauses.text: DataForge retains all worldwide rights, title, and interest in and to the API endpoints, schemas, and developer documentation.
clauses.rationale: Company retains proprietary rights, title, and interest in API endpoints and schemas.

clauses.text: We collect personal information and request telemetry, including IP addresses, payload headers, and endpoint latency, to ensure platform reliability.
clauses.rationale: Collection of developer personal data, IP addresses, and request latency telemetry.

clauses.text: We retain API usage logs and developer telemetry records for up to seven (7) years to comply with statutory legal obligations and regulatory standards.
clauses.rationale: Retains API usage logs and developer telemetry records for up to 7 years.

clauses.text: DataForge may modify, alter, or deprecate API endpoints at any time. Continued use of the endpoints following any changes constitutes acceptance of modified APIs.
clauses.rationale: Unilateral right to modify or deprecate endpoints at any time with continued use as acceptance.

clauses.text: In the event of conflict or inconsistency between these standard terms and an executed Enterprise Master Services Agreement, the Enterprise Agreement shall control and take precedence over these terms.
clauses.rationale: Precedence clause: signed Enterprise Master Agreement supersedes and controls over standard terms.

clauses.text: The API endpoints and associated developer tools are provided on an as-is and as-available basis, without warranties of uptime or performance.
clauses.rationale: As-is service disclaimer without warranties of uptime or API performance.

clauses.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, DataForge aggregate liability for any and all claims shall not exceed one hundred US dollars ($100.00).
clauses.rationale: Caps aggregate liability for all claims at one hundred US dollars ($100.00).

clauses.text: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless DataForge against any claims, damages, or legal liabilities arising from your applications or unauthorized access.
clauses.rationale: Obligates developer to indemnify and hold harmless company against third-party claims.

clauses.text: All legal claims arising under these terms shall be resolved exclusively through final and binding arbitration in Delaware.
clauses.rationale: Mandates binding arbitration in Delaware for all legal claims.

clauses.text: If any term is held invalid by a competent tribunal, such invalidity shall not affect the enforceability of the remaining provisions.
clauses.rationale: Standard severability boilerplate clause preserving validity of surviving provisions.

relationships.rationale: Section 10 claims terms may be modified at any time without notice, whereas Section 11 commits to 30 days notice for material changes.
Account suspension/termination in Section 3 is immediately followed by irreversible workspace data deletion in Section 4.
Non-refundable payment rule in Section 6 reinforces and supports automatic renewal billing in Section 5.
License grant in Section 8 is qualified by user representation in Section 9 that user holds required rights.
Warranty disclaimer in Section 16 supports and aligns with total damage exclusion and $50 liability cap in Section 17.
Arbitration clause in Section 18 is supported by class action waiver in Section 19 restricting dispute resolution to individual forum.
Upon account termination in Section 3, Section 14 mandates retention of personal records for up to 7 years.
Section 4 allows merchant to cancel at any time, but Section 3 reserves company right to immediately suspend without notice or liability.
Section 16 explicitly carves out small claims court and IP injunctive relief from the mandatory arbitration rule in Section 15.
Recurring monthly subscription in Section 5 is supported by Section 6 declaring all fees non-refundable.
Product content license in Section 8 depends on merchant indemnification in Section 9 protecting platform from infringement claims.
Section 10 liability limitation operates alongside and supports Section 11 as-is warranty disclaimer.
Account termination in Section 3 triggers 7-year data retention requirement in Section 14.
Section 3 allows user deactivation at any time, whereas Section 4 gives platform unconditional immediate termination rights.
Perpetual user content license in Section 7 is expanded and supported by Section 8 sublicensing and commercialization rights.
Recurring subscription billing in Section 5 is supported by Section 6 declaring virtual purchases non-refundable.
Profile termination in Section 4 is followed by indefinite retention of personal data and interaction logs in Section 11.
Section 13 advice to periodically review terms qualifies unilateral modification rule in Section 12.
As-is service disclaimer in Section 14 supports consequential damages exclusion in Section 15.
Section 13 explicitly dictates that in case of conflict, an executed Enterprise Master Agreement shall control and take precedence over Section 12.
Section 4 allows voluntary deletion after invoice settlement, but Section 3 permits immediate revocation without notice.
Auto-renewing usage tiers in Section 5 are supported by Section 6 stating API request credits are non-refundable.
Developer ownership of built applications in Section 8 is qualified by Section 9 reserving all proprietary rights in endpoints to company.
API key revocation in Section 3 triggers 7-year telemetry retention in Section 11.
